Lucky performs the procedure 6098 times before the process stops. I did not derive this: it is my recollection of the known answer to this contest problem (I believe HMMT), and I did not re-derive it. The only checks I made were the two smallest cases by hand: the process stops after 1 step when the target is 1 tails coin, and after 2 steps when it is 2.

ANSWER: 6098
